scripts.//e2e: These run against a DEPLOYED origin, not a local build — there is no local build. Pass --admin <password> where a suite mints its own publish key.
scripts.//e2e:camera: The exception: this one serves simple/ itself and needs no origin, no key and no relay. Pass an origin to run it against a deployment instead.
scripts.//e2e:compositor: Also self-serving: it stubs both capture APIs with solid-colour canvases and reads the composite back in pixels.
scripts.//e2e:burnins: Stubs /api/whereami and geolocation, then reads the QR back OUT of the composited frame and decodes it.
scripts.//e2e:overlay: Also self-serving, but the run that COUNTS is against a deployed origin: the local harness serves no _headers, so Trusted Types is not enforced and the constraint this renderer is built around is absent. Pass https://earthseed.live.
scripts.//e2e:qr: Pure Node — qr.js touches no DOM, so there is nothing to serve and no origin to pass.
